items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: I said to myself Mac Chrupcala never needed to do that. Never.

ctx.x: Yeah. He’s like that, and — but very flexible. And he helped me get started before I left for New York and helped me — well first he invited me to sing with his trio right in the middle of Newport, and then helped me to find a couple of gigs where I was singing and playing piano by myself. Anyway, years later I’m on a gig with him. They’re always doing a special jazz Sunday or so, blah-blah-blah. And suddenly he’s got — it’s not I don’t think, no it wasn’t an iPad, not yet, but just a phone. And he was reading…

I played at a jam session the other day and I could tell the audience needed to hear something familiar so I called “Watermelon Man.” And these musicians I was playing with all got out their phones. I’m thinking for “Watermelon Man” you need —? I mean, like you said —
